units.spread_deg: cone half-angle, hip fire; ADS x0.5
units.reload_real_seconds: full reload, or per shell when reload_per_shell
units.durability: hits/shots until broken; at <25% guns jam 10%, melee deals x0.7
units.fire_modes: semi | auto | burst | pump (manual pump between shots) | bolt (manual bolt) | break (break-action double barrel); every ranged weapon lists its modes
units.ads_spread_mult: spread multiplier when aiming down sights (default 0.5)
units.real_world_reference: exact real-world model/description the artist + modeller should match (viewmodel, paper doll, pickup sprite)

rules.falloff: damage linearly drops to 40% between falloff_start_m and range_m
rules.headshot: multiplier on enemies with a head hitbox (humans, husks)
rules.noise: enemies within noise_radius_m (x enemy hearing) are alerted and investigate
rules.broken: durability 0 = cannot attack; melee fixable by weapon_repair recipe, guns by repair_kit
rules.weapon_order_code: config WEAPONS_ORDER = knife, pipe, pistol, blaster, molotov. Extend with new ids.
rules.paperdoll: paperdoll_layer / two_handed mirror items.json (validator enforces they match).

melee.name: Shop knife
melee.real_world_reference: Mora Companion-style fixed-blade utility knife: 4.1 in (104 mm) carbon-steel drop-point blade, black rubberised polymer handle

melee.name: Lead pipe
melee.real_world_reference: About 60 cm length of rusty 1-inch black-iron / galvanised plumbing pipe, threaded at one end (no fittings)

melee.name: Baseball bat
melee.real_world_reference: Louisville Slugger-style 33-inch ash wood baseball bat, natural finish, black grip tape on the handle

melee.name: Crowbar
melee.real_world_reference: Stanley-style 36-inch steel wrecking bar: hex shaft, gooseneck claw at one end, flat pry chisel at the other; black paint with a worn red claw

melee.name: Fire axe
melee.real_world_reference: 6 lb pick-head fire axe (Council Tool-style): red-painted head with spike, 36-inch yellow fibreglass handle

ranged.name: Service 9mm
ranged.real_world_reference: Glock 17-style polymer-frame 9mm service pistol: matte black, squared slide, 4.5 in barrel, flush 15-17 round magazine (NOT a revolver or hand-cannon)
ranged.mag_note: Changed 8 -> 15 to match the Glock 17-style reference (17 nominal, 15 = worn springs/partial mags). config.js mag 8.

ranged.name: Makeshift 12ga
ranged.desc: Bridge Boys double-barrel pipe shotgun. Damage is total for all pellets at <= falloff_start_m. Magazine 2 = two barrels (config.js had 4).
ranged.real_world_reference: Improvised double-barrel 12-gauge pipe shotgun ('slam-fire'): two 3/4-in steel pipe barrels slid into 1-in pipe sleeves, hose clamps + wire wraps, scrap 2x4 wood stock, no trigger guard

ranged.name: Pump shotgun
ranged.real_world_reference: Remington 870 Wingmaster-style 12-gauge pump: 18.5-20 in blued barrel with bead sight, walnut stock and fore-end, 4+1 tube magazine

ranged.name: Deer rifle
ranged.desc: Watch and Compact militias carry these.
ranged.real_world_reference: Remington 700 ADL-style bolt-action .30-06 hunting rifle: walnut sporter stock, blued barrel, 3-9x40 scope, orange/brown sling, 4-round internal magazine

ranged.name: AR-15
ranged.desc: Civilian semi-auto AR-15 (prepper safe / car trunk / militia find). Same cartridge and damage as the M4A1, but semi-only, iron sights (looser ADS), lower durability and jams when worn. Available one act earlier than military rifles.
ranged.real_world_reference: Civilian semi-auto AR-15 carbine (Colt LE6920 / S&W M&P15-style): 16 in barrel, A2 front sight post, flat-top receiver with flip-up rear sight, 6-position collapsible stock, black, 30-round aluminium STANAG magazine

ranged.name: Service rifle
ranged.desc: Ironwood M4A1, select-fire. Military issue: most durable, red-dot optic (tighter ADS). Auto burns 5.56 fast; ammo is the limiter, not the gun.
ranged.real_world_reference: Colt M4A1 select-fire carbine (US Army issue): 14.5 in barrel, flat-top upper with M68 CCO / Aimpoint red dot, quad rail, black furniture, tan 30-round PMAG, sling

thrown.name: Molotov
thrown.real_world_reference: Clear or green 750 ml glass liquor/wine bottle filled with gasoline, cloth rag wick stuffed into the neck, lit

thrown.name: Road flare
thrown.real_world_reference: Standard 15-minute red highway fusee (Orion-style road flare): red paper tube about 30 cm long with a striker cap, burning bright red with sparks

thrown.name: Torch
thrown.real_world_reference: Improvised torch: about 50 cm broom-handle / branch with fuel-soaked cloth wrapped around the top, burning
